extensionDescription.message: An extension for jut.su that allows videos to play automatically, skip anime intros, and automatically start the next episode.

extension_description.message:
Turns the extension on or off.
When off, all features stop working. In Firefox (and some browsers), allow autoplay in the tab for episode auto-start.

mark_video_timeline.message: Mark intro and credits on timeline

next_series_before_end_description.message:
Switches to the next episode as soon as credits start.
Triggers when the credits begin rolling.

next_series_after_end_description.message:
Switches to the next episode after credits end.
Waits until the video is fully done.

next_series_off_description.message:
Disables automatic switching to the next episode.
The current video will not advance further.

skip_intro_description.message:
Skips anime intros automatically.
Saves time for faster watching.

skip_intro_fix_description.message:
Fixes issues with skipping anime intros.
Ensures smooth transitions.

video_from_start_description.message:
Starts videos from the beginning, ignoring past progress.
Perfect for rewatching.

click_to_fullscreen_description.message:
Adds an overlay for quick fullscreen access.
Fullscreen: Go fullscreen
Exit: Close the overlay
Designed for phones to replace two taps with one click.

add_speed_control_description.message:
Adds a speed control panel to the player.
A button appears, and on hover, a slider pops up.
Speeds: 0.5x to 2x, adjustable in 0.1 steps.

mark_video_timeline_description.message:
Shows markers on the timeline:
- Yellow: Opening
- Red: Credits start
Uses player data; markers might sometimes be missing.

pseudo_fullscreen_description.message:
Turns on Pseudo-fullscreen mode.
You can still use the player controls.
In Chrome, the cursor hides if you don’t move the mouse.
A button appears in the player to turn it on or off.
Press 'T' for a quick switch.
The button stays even when the mode is off. In browser fullscreen (F11), it acts like true fullscreen—only the video player is visible—and works across episodes.

page_description.message: This page provides information about all extension features, allowing you to modify them, along with a list of available shortcuts.

settings_description.message: Here’s a description of how various extension features work.

shortcuts_description.message: Here are the shortcuts and their functions.

shortcut_numbers_desc.message:
Jump to a percentage of the video.
'0' starts from the beginning, '5' jumps to the middle.

shortcut_f_desc.message:
Switches to fullscreen mode.
Quickly changes the viewing size.

shortcut_m_desc.message:
Turns sound on or off.
Mute without pausing.

shortcut_t_desc.message:
Switches Pseudo-fullscreen mode.
Works only if 'Pseudo-fullscreen mode' is on.
